newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Cenbank mulls higher reserve requirement.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Cenbank mulls higher reserve requirement.

text.p: Venezuela's Central Bank is considering increasing the reserve requirement for commercial banks from 15 to 17 percent in an effort to reduce excess liquidity levels, Central Bank Director Domingo Maza Zavala said Friday.
"There is the possibility of raising the reserve requirement to 17 percent," Maza told Union Radio in an interview.
Maza added that the additional two percentage points could be interest bearing.
The Central Bank raised the percentage of their deposits which banks must place in non-interest bearing accounts at the Central Bank from 12 to 15 percent July 10.

Money market traders have said the increase in the reserve requirement had little effect on the high levels of liquidity which have brought the local bolivar currency under increasing pressure in recent weeks.
